name: anywhere-backend
description: Bundler for Utools plugin preload scripts

scripts.build: pnpm exec esbuild src/preload.js src/window_preload.js src/fast_window_preload.js --bundle --minify --platform=node --outdir=./public --format=cjs --external:electron --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3 --legal-comments=none && pnpm exec esbuild src/lazy_runtime.js --bundle --minify --platform=node --outfile=./public/lazy_runtime.js --format=cjs --external:electron --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3 --legal-comments=none && pnpm exec esbuild src/file_runtime.js --bundle --minify --platform=node --outfile=./public/file_runtime.js --format=cjs --external:electron --legal-comments=none && pnpm exec esbuild src/projects_runtime.js --bundle --minify --platform=node --outfile=./public/projects_runtime.js --format=cjs --external:electron --legal-comments=none && pnpm exec esbuild src/conversation_runtime.js --bundle --minify --platform=node --outfile=./public/conversation_runtime.js --format=cjs --external:electron --legal-comments=none && node scripts/copy-sqlite-native.js
scripts.watch: pnpm exec esbuild src/preload.js src/window_preload.js src/fast_window_preload.js src/lazy_runtime.js src/file_runtime.js src/projects_runtime.js src/conversation_runtime.js --bundle --platform=node --outdir=./public --format=cjs --external:electron --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3 --watch
